SSC CHSL Syllabus 2026 - Check Tier 1 & Tier 2 Exam Pattern, Subject-Wise PDF - Complete Details

Check SSC CHSL Syllabus 2026 for Tier 1 and Tier 2 subject-wise topics, exam pattern, marking scheme, category-wise qualifying marks, PDF download link and a preparation strategy, based on the official SSC pattern.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination (SSC CHSL) 2026
  • Notification Release Date : 7 September 2026
  • Application Dates : 7 September 2026 to 7 October 2026 (11:00 PM)

Application Fee

  • Posts : Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), Data Entry Operator (DEO), Data Entry Operator Grade 'A'
  • Selection Stages : Tier 1 (CBT), Tier 2 (CBT + Skill Test/Typing Test), Document Verification
  • Tier 1 Questions / Marks : 100 questions / 200 marks
  • General Intelligence : 25
  • General Awareness : 25
  • OBC / EWS : 25%
  • All other categories (SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen, etc.) : 20%
